name: Thoughts Of Suicide
overview: Scripture addresses the weight of despair with the assurance that the LORD fights on behalf of His people and calls them to trust Him in their distress, as seen in Exodus 14:14 and Psalms 34:17. Believers are encouraged to patiently wait on the Lord, who hears their cries and delivers them from troubles (Psalms 40:1; 50:15). The command in Leviticus 19:28 forbids harming oneself, underscoring the sanctity of life. Ultimately, God’s promise in Psalms 118:17 affirms that His people will live to proclaim His works, providing hope beyond the darkest thoughts.
